rationale.oversight-explanation: evaluates uncertainty highlighting to help humans judge code completions
rationale.built-system: built a working IDE prototype with highlighting for the study
rationale.assistive: evaluates inline snippet-level code completions in an IDE
rationale.risk-quality: evaluates highlighting to mitigate logical errors, measuring task accuracy
rationale.risk-overreliance: evaluates highlighting to reduce uncritical token acceptance via survival rates
rationale.method-experiment: controlled user study with 30 programmers and randomized highlighting conditions
rationale.method-self-report: collects subjective utility, rankings, and NASA-TLX cognitive load scores
